turns.replyText:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, damaged items are handled differently than a normal return.

For live plants:

We do not accept returns on live plants.
If a plant arrives damaged or you have concerns about its condition on arrival, you contact us instead of sending it back.
Our garden advisors review your photos and order details and then decide next steps under our guarantee (typically this may lead to store credit if a claim is approved, rather than a refund or a physical return).

For non-plant items (tools, supports, etc.):

Most unused, non-plant items can be returned within 14–30 days, and you would mail them back in new, unopened condition. Customers are responsible for return shipping for standard returns.
Garden markers that are custom engraved are not returnable unless there is an issue with the engraving.
If a non-plant item arrives damaged or defective, you still reach out to us first with photos, and our team will review and advise on next steps.

If you’d like, tell me what item was damaged (plant or non-plant), and I can walk you through exactly what to do next for your specific situation.
